title: Reference an exact sheet-layout revision
description: Bind each label project to one exact immutable sheet-layout revision and return actionable recovery when the reference is missing, unreadable, or incompatible.
acceptanceCriteria: A project stores both sheet-layout identity and exact revision number or immutable revision identifier
Opening a valid project resolves that exact revision rather than the latest revision
A missing referenced layout or revision returns a structured refusal with recovery actions
An incompatible schema or invalid geometry returns a distinct structured refusal
The application never substitutes fallback, latest, or guessed geometry silently

steps.details: Add a serializable project reference containing stable sheet-layout identity plus exact immutable revision identity, with schema validation at decode time.
Create a resolver returning the validated revision or a typed missing-layout, missing-revision, unsupported-schema, or invalid-geometry refusal.
Allow selection from available exact revisions and save the reference atomically with the project draft without mutating the revision.
Show the failed reference and actions to choose another existing revision or return to Sheet layouts; do not auto-select a replacement.
Create two revisions, bind the project to the first, reload and prove it remains selected; then remove or corrupt a fixture reference and assert actionable refusal.

technicalNotes: Projects reference immutable revisions, never mutable latest values.
Recovery must be user-directed because changing geometry can alter printable placement.
